event_summary: A lit flame at the end of a slender stick approaches a black balloon on a tabletop, after which the balloon rapidly disappears and small dark fragments move away.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a glossy black balloon resting on a wooden tabletop near the left side, a round black base on the right, and a slender light-colored stick extending from the base with a small orange flame at its free end. The flame-bearing end moves in an arc from the lower right toward the balloon. The flame reaches the lower-right area of the balloon. Immediately after contact, the balloon is no longer present as a round object, and several small dark pieces appear blurred in motion above and to the left of where the balloon had been. In later frames the tabletop area where the balloon stood is empty, the stick remains extended from the round base, and faint wisps or marks are visible near the former balloon position.

reasons: The black balloon, tabletop, round base, and extended stick are visible.
The flame is visible near the lower-right edge but is partly close to the frame boundary.
